text_block_list.text:
After running a great race, Copano Rickey
returned to the underground walkway, panting for breath.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... Yup, performance gets a passing grade☆
My running has gotten way better!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(Still, the way things are now is a dead end.
This is my limit. To move forward from here...)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(Unless we elevate each other's qi, we won't reach it.
Yes, the principles of feng shui say—)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: "'Harmony of the Four Gods.' Only when powerful Umamusume, acting as the Four Gods, reign over every cardinal direction can the whole resonate and flourish."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
There's me, Tarumae, Acute-san, and as a true legend
who doesn't race much these days—Falco-san.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Without Tarumae, who's a key part of it,
we won't be able to grow stronger...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: I wonder if seeing today's race made Tarumae want to run one more time?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
No, in the first place, did you watch
today's race? Because if you didn't...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Is there no longer any way to deliver the flame—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Ricky-chan~.
I wonder how it looked to Tarumae-chan.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Acute-san...
I don't understand. I just don't understand.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Just like Acute-san said,
maybe all I can do is look at the long run, believe, and wait.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: That's true. All I can do is watch over her, but still...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ricky-chan has that, you know, what was it...
"Feng Shui", is it called?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Can't we fix this somehow
with some kind of mystical power?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Acute-san...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Right—Feng Shui.
I have Feng Shui on my side.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The power to make everyone happy!
Right now, Tarumae is struggling so much!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Feng shui isn't magic. It can't change
the world in an instant. But still—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Setting the stage—is something I can do!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you got a second?!
It's about our next race!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
From a feng shui perspective, there's a race I just have to run.
Could you leave this one to me?
choice_data_list: Sure, but what do you mean, "feng shui-wise"...?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, the dragon veins are severed.
The veins connecting Tarumae to her hometown, Tomakomai."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
If I don't connect this, nobody will be happy.
That's why—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I'll connect it! I'm the only one who can!
Because with Feng Shui, I can influence the flow!

And so, Copano Rickey returned resolutely
to the racecourse stands, and—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: "Everyone in the crowd! Listen up!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"For my next race—
I'm entering the Mile Championship Nambu Hai!!"
(Ooooh...)

The Mile Championship Nambu Hai is a GⅠ held
in October. Its defining characteristic is—

The first dirt GⅠ of the autumn-winter season, held at
Morioka Racecourse in Iwate. In other words—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
If you live nearby, please come watch at the venue!☆
Especially folks from Tohoku! If you can!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
For the people of Hokkaido too! I'll definitely, ab-so-lutely
make this the best race of the year!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I swear to the Four Gods that many Umamusume
who feel the same way I do will gather here!!
(UOOOOOOOOOH!)
It was a silent challenge, and at the same time, a message.

To reconnect Hokko Tarumae
with her fans in Tomakomai once again.
And the next day—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(Tarumae... Tarumae might not
believe in feng shui. Even so—)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(Even Tarumae is within reach!
If I believe, I know she is.)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I won't let you just disappear like this.
I refuse to allow that—!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"We'll definitely get Tarumae back on her feet!
At the Mile Championship Nambu Hai,
no matter what!"
